Probe coverage analysis report

Source: R/sem_coverage_analysis_report.R
sem_coverage_analysis_report.Rd

Generate a coverage analysis report for Illumina methylation array data, summarising probe representation across genomic regions. WGBS data are not supported and will cause the function to stop with an informative error.

Usage

sem_coverage_analysis_report(
  signal_data,
  result_folder,
  maxResources = 90,
  parallel_strategy = "multisession",
  ...
)

Arguments

signal_data

character. Path to the signal parquet file under Data/Pivots/SIGNAL/, or a data.frame already loaded into memory. The file is named SIGNAL_<FIGURE>_PROBE_WHOLE_<GENOME_BUILD>.parquet, where FIGURE is the scale the run was written on - BETA for a proportion bounded in [0,1], MVALUE for the logit-transformed one.

result_folder

character. Path to the SEMseeker result folder.

maxResources

numeric. Maximum percentage of CPU cores to use (default 90).

parallel_strategy

character. Parallelisation backend passed to future (default "multisession"). Asking for "multicore" is accepted and converted to "multisession": it means fork(), which is unsafe with this package's native thread pool on every platform that offers it, and absent on Windows. The conversion is logged.

...

Additional named arguments passed to core_init_env().

Value

Invisibly NULL. Coverage tables and charts are written to the result folder.

Examples

result_dir <- tempdir()
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# BETA is the scale this particular run was written on; a run on the
# logit scale produces SIGNAL_MVALUE_PROBE_WHOLE_HG19.parquet instead.
sem_coverage_analysis_report(
  signal_data   = "~/semseeker_results/Data/Pivots/SIGNAL/SIGNAL_BETA_PROBE_WHOLE_HG19.parquet",
  result_folder = "~/semseeker_results/"
)
} # }
